_comment: Per-PR demo for #1379: the line-relief corridor no longer fans every back rank the moment the swap arms. Deliberately records the SAME input script as #1348 / #1377, unchanged -- do not re-stage this scenario without re-staging demos/inputs/relief-fighting-withdrawal.json in step, or that controlled pair stops being a pair.
caption: Line relief corridor, ranks the partner actually occupies. Same scenario as the line_relief clip -- a 60-man Infantry front block ground down holding a 70-man enemy, relieved at tick 200 by a full-strength unit behind it. Watch the reliever's front-adjacent ranks open a lane as it closes, while its own rear stays closed until the tired unit is actually falling back through it -- the whole block no longer fans the moment the order arms.
